title: Research (no κ claim): successor hand-off of productive conduit helpers — new native pattern, verified gadget, pricing, exact screens on #4610
body:
New native pattern. A successor helper starts idle at a mid frame F. At F the conduit helper's carried port data is cancelled with co-framed ADDs, the conduit passes to the successor, and consumers above F pre-subtract the successor's input. The paid climbs stay the same, and one rank-(a+b) productive target becomes a + b.

- **Gadget (checked).** An exact replay on F2^5 under literal_replay rules, with the interpreter control-matched to the #4610 word in both orientations. Targets go from [5] to [3,2] at the same paid profile {1:12, 2:2, 3:1}, and three mutation controls are rejected.
- **Pricing.** A 9→4+5 hand-off in each of the 18 locals adds +1.36e-6 to the raw root. A single hand-off would beat U = 0.00302728825 in raw root.
- **Exact screens on #4610.** No hand-off point exists. Co-framed cancellation, deferred cancellation and pre-subtraction all find nothing. The only span-feasible points are entrance-pure ones, and their spread inputs are recollected only at the top frame.
- **Requirement for a real gain.** A new native word in which helper flags cross port flags at mid frames.

Package: `research/helper-handoff-r18`. Verify with `sh research/helper-handoff-r18/verify.sh`, which prints PASS_HELPER_HANDOFF_R18.

**Credits:** Cao Yifan (#4610), zxv (#4359, literal_replay), Clear1nsight (#5413), #5409, Matarener (#5422/#5426/#5433), aliromman (#5383), #4441/#4470, Aaron Wang (#3039).
